description: This Java source file defines the implementation of the DownstreamSenderFactory interface, responsible for creating and managing downstream sender instances for telemetry and event data within the Eclipse Hono client framework. It includes methods to create senders, handle disconnections, and manage client cache, with interaction via Vert.x event bus.

classes.name: DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DownstreamSenderFactory interface, managing creation and caching of downstream senders for telemetry and event messages, as well as handling tenant timeouts.

methods.name: DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a HonoConnection and setting up tenant timeout consumer.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection event by clearing client cache.

methods.name: getOrCreateTelemetrySender
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or retrieves a telemetry sender for a given tenant.

methods.name: getOrCreateEventSender
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or retrieves an event sender for a given tenant.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages, closing and removing associated downstream sender clients.
